title: CME Globex Notice: Livestock markets move to dedicated Market Segments and MDP channels
summary: To prepare the Livestock migration to Google Cloud (Q4 2026 Production-Dallas), CME launches dedicated Market Segments and MDP channels on-premise; Livestock trades on the new segments and channels from 2026-08-16. Clients must connect to new multicast channels and new MSGW/Drop Copy instances. New Release testing from 2026-07-21.
